text:
Alex W: quick q from acme SI — do they need prod creds for the pen run or can we provide sanitized artifacts + presigned upload?
Priya S: partner asked for 'authenticated scans' in their note. we should avoid prod creds.
Marco (SI): we can do authenticated scans but not on prod creds. a scoped service account or ephemeral role is fine. need list of endpoints + sample curl.
Jun: ops preference = presigned PUTs for uploads + ephemeral IAM role for active scans. presign TTL ~24h works.
Alex W: security concern = long-lived keys. prefer presign + short-role that expires after the scan completes. also need redaction guidance for PII in logs.
Priya S: also need SOC2 artifacts for the marketplace listing — redacted PDF + audit contact info. will flag which sections are redacted.
Marco (SI): SOC2 redaction ok. for pen test we need inbound/outbound IP ranges, auth endpoints, and optionally DNS logs.
Jun: example presign command I plan to run for partner uploads:\n```\naws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/pen_uploads/partner_acme_2026.zip --expires-in 86400\n```\nAlex W: perfect. also please KMS-encrypt the bucket and enable server-side encryption.
Ops-Bot: presign link created for partner_acme_2026.zip -> https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketplace/pen_uploads/partner_acme_2026.zip?X-Amz-... (expires in 24h) :white_check_mark:
security-bot: reminder — enforce kms encryption, set object lock retention=7d for artifacts, and include a redaction manifest that lists which fields were removed/hashed.
Priya S: action items: 1) i'll draft redaction checklist + SOC export template by EOD, 2) Jun will provision presign + ephemeral role, 3) Marco to confirm exact scan scope.
Marco (SI): can you also include whether you can provide HTTP access logs (masked) and DNS resolution logs? those help with C2 detection.
Jun: we can produce masked access logs (mask IPs) and short-lived DNS snapshots. will note retention policy.
Alex W: scheduling — quick runbook sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? 20m to confirm handoff and validate presign flow.
Marco (SI): works for me.
Priya S: i've penciled it into the calendar. @Alex W — i'll attach the draft checklist after the call. :thumbsup:
Alex W: thanks all — keeping this scoped tight reduces blast radius.
